introduction.title: Less Noise.
introduction.lead: Research should help you see beyond the consensus.
paragraphs: Our research combines economic analysis, country-level intelligence, quantitative models and market insight to develop independent views on the markets we cover.
From sovereign fundamentals and debt sustainability to political developments and relative value, we focus on the factors that drive investment decisions.

research.label: EMFI Intelligence Reports
research.notice: Publication and chart snapshot from EMFI Intelligence, imported 21 October 2026.

workstation.title: Insight into
workstation.lead: Understanding the opportunity is only the beginning.
paragraphs: Our sales and trading team works directly with clients and counterparties to source liquidity, assess pricing and execute transactions.
We combine market knowledge with specialist execution capabilities, focusing on the details that matter: price, liquidity, timing and settlement.
workstation.name: The EMFI Workstation
workstation.description: A dedicated execution interface connecting market information, trading activity and transaction workflows.

disclosures.title: Regulatory & research information
disclosures.regulation: is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), United Kingdom. Reference Number: 763979.
paragraphs: Execution services are provided to eligible professional clients, subject to applicable regulatory permissions, client classification and execution arrangements.
Research is provided for informational purposes and does not constitute a personal recommendation or an offer to buy or sell financial instruments.
